Ananya Guha

Email Id: ananyaguha1994@gmail.com

Mobile: +91-8276864324 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/ananya-guha

PROFILE SUMMARY

Senior Business Analyst with 9+ years of BFSI experience across Commercial Lending, Pricing and Trade Finance. Expertise in requirements elicitation, impact assessment, data analysis, Agile delivery and translating complex business needs into technology solutions. Strong experience in stakeholder management, backlog prioritization and delivering data-driven solutions aligned with business value, operational efficiency and governance.

KEY SKILLS

Requirements Gathering & Analysis Change Management,BRD,FRD Trade Finance Workflow

Product Roadmap & Delivery Solution Design & Data Analysis Commercial Lending & Pricing

Stakeholder Engagement Release Planning & Execution Risk, Issue & Dependency Management

CORE COMPETENCIES

Strong analytical skills with experience identifying trends and supporting strategic decisions • Data-driven decision-making using dashboards, reporting insights and business impact analysis • End-to-end workflow optimization and scalable solution delivery across enterprise banking platforms • Strong stakeholder management with the ability to bridge business, technology and cross-functional teams

WORK EXPERIENCE

Senior Business Analyst (Senior AVP) at Wells Fargo, Hyderabad from September’24 to present Project – Commercial Lending & Pricing Platform (Relationship Pricer)

Key Action Areas:

Defined product vision, roadmap and backlog strategy with stakeholders, enhancing delivery clarity by ~25% • Developed data mappings, analyzed data models and validated ETL transformations and data warehouse load • Designed API contracts, integration specifications and data flow designs to enhance platform capabilities • Leveraged SQL and Power BI to analyze business data, identify trends and support product decisions • Prepared stakeholder discussions, governance updates and delivery status reports to support business • Applied AI tools to analyze data, identify trends, and enable process optimization and operational efficiency

Consultant at Deloitte USI, Hyderabad from July’21 to September’24 Project – Internal Enterprise Transformation Program

Key Action Areas:

Defined data requirements, transformation rules and reporting specifications for business initiatives • • Coordinated business readiness activities and change adoption across transformation initiatives • Developed status reports and meeting communications to support program governance and alignment • Owned test scenario definition, output validation and defect resolution coordination for high-quality releases

Led As-Is/To-Be analysis, impact assessments and risk analysis, enabling ~15% efficiency improvement

Technology Analyst at Infosys Ltd., Pune from June’19 to July’21 Client – UBS, Switzerland

Key Action Areas:

Managed RAID logs, governance reporting and project plans to improve project execution by ~30% • • Directed backlog prioritization, refinement and roadmap planning aligned with product strategy • • Designed wireframes to translate business needs into intuitive UI/UX, improving developer understanding Led Sprint Ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews and Retrospectives

Shaped Epics and decomposed them into user stories with acceptance criteria aligned with trade workflows

Senior Analyst at Capgemini Technology Services India Ltd., Mumbai from Nov’16 to June’19 Client – HSBC, Hong Kong and Servier, France

Key Action Areas:

Facilitated discovery sessions with stakeholders to align requirements, priorities and solution outcomes • Documented BRD, FRD, and SRS artifacts along with BPMN process design and ERD for database design • Achieved 90%+ release readiness via 100% RTM (Requirements Traceability Matrix) coverage • • Contributed to application development using .NET Framework, C#, Node.js, Angular 4 and SQL Server Supported SIT/UAT, release implementation and business adoption activities across cross-functional teams

IT SKILLS

Requirement & Collaboration Tools : JIRA, Confluence, ServiceNow (SNOW), SharePoint, MS Office Prototyping & Modelling : Figma, Axure RP9, MS Visio Data & Reporting : SQL, Power BI, MS Excel API Integration & Monitoring Tools : Postman, Swagger, Splunk Data Integration & ETL : Informatica, Snowflake, AWS S3 Development & IDE Tools : Visual Studio 2015, Visual Studio Code, SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) 2012 Technologies & Development : .NET, C#, Angular 4, SQL Server Methodologies : Agile (Kanban / Scrum / SAFe), Waterfall

EDUCATION

B.Tech in Information Technology from West Bengal University of Technology, Kolkata in 2016 with CGPA 8.63/10

sections.label: Experience
sections.text:
WORK EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst (Senior AVP) at Wells Fargo, Hyderabad from September’24 to present Project – Commercial Lending & Pricing Platform (Relationship Pricer)
Key Action Areas:
Defined product vision, roadmap and backlog strategy with stakeholders, enhancing delivery clarity by ~25% • Developed data mappings, analyzed data models and validated ETL transformations and data warehouse load • Designed API contracts, integration specifications and data flow designs to enhance platform capabilities • Leveraged SQL and Power BI to analyze business data, identify trends and support product decisions • Prepared stakeholder discussions, governance updates and delivery status reports to support business • Applied AI tools to analyze data, identify trends, and enable process optimization and operational efficiency
Consultant at Deloitte USI, Hyderabad from July’21 to September’24 Project – Internal Enterprise Transformation Program
Key Action Areas:
Defined data requirements, transformation rules and reporting specifications for business initiatives • • Coordinated business readiness activities and change adoption across transformation initiatives • Developed status reports and meeting communications to support program governance and alignment • Owned test scenario definition, output validation and defect resolution coordination for high-quality releases
Led As-Is/To-Be analysis, impact assessments and risk analysis, enabling ~15% efficiency improvement
Technology Analyst at Infosys Ltd., Pune from June’19 to July’21 Client – UBS, Switzerland
Key Action Areas:
Managed RAID logs, governance reporting and project plans to improve project execution by ~30% • • Directed backlog prioritization, refinement and roadmap planning aligned with product strategy • • Designed wireframes to translate business needs into intuitive UI/UX, improving developer understanding Led Sprint Ceremonies including Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews and Retrospectives
Shaped Epics and decomposed them into user stories with acceptance criteria aligned with trade workflows
Senior Analyst at Capgemini Technology Services India Ltd., Mumbai from Nov’16 to June’19 Client – HSBC, Hong Kong and Servier, France
Key Action Areas:
Facilitated discovery sessions with stakeholders to align requirements, priorities and solution outcomes • Documented BRD, FRD, and SRS artifacts along with BPMN process design and ERD for database design • Achieved 90%+ release readiness via 100% RTM (Requirements Traceability Matrix) coverage • • Contributed to application development using .NET Framework, C#, Node.js, Angular 4 and SQL Server Supported SIT/UAT, release implementation and business adoption activities across cross-functional teams
